_: The takedown ledger. One entry per asset the company has REMOVED from live
prove — on demand, against production — that every one of them is still gone.
WHY IT IS NOT ENOUGH TO SET status_guna: ditarik-balik IN THE REGISTER.
On 01 Sept 2026 both files below were deleted from R2 and from the database,
both articles stopped referencing them, and all six object URLs kept
returning HTTP 200 with cf-cache-status: HIT. The edge holds them under
`Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. Deleted at origin is not
gone, and the register has no column that would have noticed.
A takedown appends an entry here in the same sitting it appends to
log_takedown. `pageUrls` and `control` are what make the gate honest: without
a retained image on the same page to check, a 500, a DNS failure or a typo'd
stem all read as a clean pass.
